predictions.rationale: Central bootstrap for Identity microservice; wires IdentityServer, authentication schemes, token issuance and protection for other services, directly embodying the feature.
Implements user-facing actions such as login, logout, registration and account management; explicit handling of authentication workflows.
Defines IdentityServer resources, clients and scopes, thus configuring how access tokens are issued and validated.
Service that validates credentials against the EF store; core to authenticating users and generating claims for tokens.
Supplies user claims to IdentityServer during token creation and introspection, directly influencing the content of issued tokens.
Entity Framework context holding user, role and identity tables; underpins persistence for registration and account management.
Domain model representing authenticated users, extended from Identity framework; fundamental to user accounts.
Seeds initial users and roles into the Identity database, supporting bootstrapping of authentication scenarios.
Interface defining authentication contract; central abstraction for login logic used by controllers.
Handles user consent flow for token issuance to clients, contributing to secure authorization processes.
